title: Istanbul Stone
facts: The product is a natural stone material known as Istanbul stone, originating from Brazil. It features a distinctive ivory, cream, and gray color pattern with amber streaks. In its imported form, the stone measures approximately 2 meters in length, 3 meters in height, and is available in thicknesses of either 2 or 3 centimeters. The surface of the stone, including the top and sides, is polished, and the edges are beveled for a finished appearance. After importation, the stone will be cut to specific sizes and shapes for use in both indoor and outdoor applications. Common uses include countertops, wall cladding, table surfaces, and flooring. Laboratory analysis confirms the material composition as granite.

title: Piracema White Stone
facts: The goods are a natural stone material known as Piracema White, sourced from Brazil. The stone exhibits a light gray base color with dark gray and black streaks and banding. Each piece measures approximately 115 to 122 inches in length, 65 to 75 inches in width, and is available in two thicknesses: 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches. The surface of the stone is polished, while the sides are cut or sawn. After importation, the stone will be cut to specific sizes and shapes for use as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and office furniture surfaces.

title: Safic-Chem REC
facts: The product is N-Phenyl-N-(trichloromethylsulfenyl)-benzenesulfonamide, marketed as Safic-Chem REC. It functions as a medical intermediate and rubber vulcanizing agent. It is supplied as a dry powder in bulk form. The dry powder is combined with calcium carbonate, which serves as a stabilizer, and hydrotreated heavy paraffinic distillate (petroleum), which functions as a dedusting agent. The goods are imported from China.

title: Aviation Headset Cables
facts: These are three types of cables for use with the Zulu aviation headset. The first is a Mic Driver Jumper, part number 300-00014-000.A1, containing four individually insulated conductor wires. One end terminates in a 5-pin “Pico” connector; the opposite end remains unterminated. This cable connects the speaker and microphone inside the headset and transmits audio, power, and active noise cancellation signals. The second cable, part number 300-00044-000.A3, is a Tinsel Cup Breakout for the right side. It features a length of insulated conductor with a 6-POS connector on one end and an unterminated opposite end. It links the right earcup to the internal harness and carries audio, power, and active noise cancellation signals. The third cable, part number 300-00045-000.A3, is a Tinsel Cup Breakout for the left side, matching the right-side cable in construction and function. It connects the left earcup to the internal harness and also transmits audio, power, and active noise cancellation signals.

title: Emergency Jack Cable
facts: The product is an emergency jack cable identified by part number 300-00031-000.A2. It consists of multiple individually insulated cable conductors. One end of the cable terminates in a 3.5mm stereo receptacle, while the other end terminates in a multi-pin connector. The cable connects to the printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) located within the earcup of an aviation headset. It allows the user to connect a power and audio cable to the stereo jack, enabling the routing of both audio and power signals to the headset. This functionality is intended to provide power and audio in cases of wireless link failure or battery depletion. The cable is designed specifically for use with aviation headsets.

title: Mystical Charmer Adult Costume
facts: The costume is an adult-sized ensemble that includes a long-sleeved pullover top, a skirt, a hip sash, a headband, and a set of Tarot cards. The pullover top is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features a lace-up front design. The neck edges are folded over once and stitched with long, loose, straight stitching. The off-the-shoulder sleeves have raw, unfinished edges at the top and bottom, with narrow, exposed elastic stitched using a single line of long, loose straight stitching at both the top and bottom of each sleeve. The bottom hem of the top is also folded over once and stitched with a single line of long, loose straight stitching.

title: Renaissance Peasant Blouse
facts: This is an adult-size blouse available in cream (item number 5020-019) and black (item number 5020-020). It is made from a flimsy, man-made, loose-weave textile fabric. The design can be worn on or off the shoulder. The neckline has large, visible, loose overlock stitching with exposed elastic stitched using a single line of long, very loose straight stitching. Each sleeve includes two strips of exposed elastic stitched with a single line of long, very loose straight stitching—one strip near the elbow and the other halfway between the shoulder and elbow. The blouse features long sleeves and a hem bottom, both with large, visible, loose overlock stitching.

title: Poultry Nutritional Supplements
facts: The merchandise consists of four nutritional preparations intended for poultry, including broilers, layers, and turkeys. Each product is administered by dilution in drinking water for nutritional and physiological support only and contains no veterinary drugs or medicated feed. Chick’N™ Calcium contains vitamins and minerals. Chick’N™ Vitamins+ (also marketed as Chick’N™ Vita+) contains vitamins A, D3, E, B-complex, and C; minerals including calcium, magnesium, sodium, potassium, zinc, and copper; amino acids such as lysine and methionine; and carriers including maltodextrin and mineral salts. Chick’N™ Electrolyte (also known as Chick’N™ Electro+) contains vitamins A, D3, E, B-complex, and C; minerals including calcium, magnesium, sodium, and potassium; and carriers such as maltodextrin and mineral salts. Chick’N™ Prebiotic+ (also marketed as Chick’N™ Prebio+) contains vitamins E and C; prebiotic substances including inulin and yeast derivatives; and carriers such as maltodextrin and mineral salts. All products are formulated specifically for use through drinking water to supplement poultry diets.

title: Bearing Steel Balls
facts: These are polished steel balls made from SUJ2 graded steel, each weighing 10.02 grams. The balls are manufactured to precise tolerances, with the maximum and minimum diameters varying by no more than 0.00008 millimeters from the nominal diameter. They are intended for use in bearings to minimize friction in steering columns, wheel hub units, and pumps. The product is supplied as individual balls, ready for integration into bearing assemblies.

title: Wearable LED Patch Devices
facts: These devices are small, battery-powered electronic patches that incorporate LEDs to emit blue and/or red light. Each patch includes a cosmetic ingredient layer, an adhesive backing, and a control Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA). The patch is designed to be applied directly to the user's face, using emitted light for cosmetic skincare purposes such as soothing, recovery, and hydration. Intended for at-home use, the device does not require a prescription from a medical professional. The patches are imported in various configurations but function similarly, providing a non-medical treatment through light emission.

title: Foldable Handheld Fan
facts: The item is a foldable handheld fan intended for personal cooling by waving it back and forth to generate airflow. It consists of a body made from 100 percent cotton woven digital printed fabric and a frame composed of ribs/sticks made from Cupressus funebris wood. The folded fabric is glued to the wood ribs on one side, and the wood frames are held together by a metal rivet at the bottom. When fully opened, the fan measures 18 inches in length by 9 inches in height, and when closed, it measures 1 ½ inches in length by 9 inches in height.

title: Roflumilast Powder
facts: The product is Roflumilast, identified by CAS Number 162401-32-3. It is supplied in bulk form as a fine powder. The powder is used in pharmaceutical applications for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). It functions as a selective phosphodiesterase 4 (PDE4) inhibitor. The product is provided without any additional packaging beyond bulk containers suitable for pharmaceutical manufacturing or further processing.

title: Motor Vehicle Radio Receiver
facts: The product is an audio media receiver model MVH-S230BT designed for use in motor vehicles. It features an AM and FM tuner and includes Bluetooth connectivity and a USB input for connecting to portable devices such as smartphones, MP3 players, or USB drives. The unit can read and playback sound directly from a USB memory device. This after-market radio receiver is specifically intended to replace a standard car stereo system in a motor vehicle.

title: Halloween Decorative Potion Bottle
facts: The item is a Halloween decoration shaped like a spooky potion bottle, measuring approximately 9.6 inches in height, 3.6 inches in width, and 4.0 inches in depth. It is designed to resemble an apothecary bottle with a black finish and features a black and gold stopper on top. A large, frightening black and gold spider is wrapped around the front of the bottle, positioned above a 'Spider Venom' label. The decoration is non-functional and cannot be opened. It is intended to be marketed and sold as an eerie decorative piece for Halloween festivities.

title: Clodronic Acid Disodium Salt Tetrahydrate
facts: The product is Clodronic Acid Disodium Salt Tetrahydrate, identified by CAS Number 88416-50-6. It is supplied in bulk powder form. This compound is a first-generation non-nitrogenous bisphosphonate. The product is used in medical applications for the treatment of hypercalcemia associated with malignancies, osteoporosis, and Paget’s disease. It is manufactured and exported from Italy.

title: Evil Sultan Adult Costume
facts: The costume is an adult-sized theatrical outfit that includes a long-sleeved robe, a cape, and a turban headpiece. The robe is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features a two-piece collar with a deep back opening. The raw edges of the back opening are closed with two small patches of hook and loop fastener. The long sleeves and hem bottom are also raw and unfinished, and the robe is stitched together with a single line of long, loose, straight stitching. The costume is intended for wear as a theatrical or themed outfit by adults and is sold as a complete set in its retail packaging.

title: Etripamil Bulk Powder
facts: The product is Etripamil, identified by CAS Number 1593673-23-4. It is supplied in bulk powder form. The active ingredient is a non-dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker. The product functions as a pharmaceutical agent intended for medical use in converting acute symptomatic episodes of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (PSVT) to sinus rhythm. It is designed for adult patients. The goods are imported from Italy and are provided without any packaging beyond bulk containers suitable for pharmaceutical processing or further formulation.

title: Interstellar Innovation Fine Lunar Regolith Simulant (IIFLRS)
facts: The product is natural basalt stone mined in Australia. The basalt is crushed and packaged for retail sale without any further processing or working. After importation into the United States, the material will be used to produce a lunar regolith simulant that replicates the composition of the moon’s surface. This simulant is intended to support NASA and commercial lunar activities. The product is supplied in packaged form ready for retail distribution.

title: Aviation Headset Ear Cups
facts: These are left and right faceted ear cup assemblies for the Zulu 3 aviation headset. Each assembly includes a dome-shaped magnesium housing that forms the outer structure of the ear cup. The design creates a physical barrier and seal around the ear. This seal isolates and blocks external noise, supporting both passive and active noise reduction functions of the headset. The components are sold separately as part numbers 303-00035-000.A1 for the left cup and 303-00036-000.A1 for the right cup. They are delivered ready for integration into the complete headset unit.

title: Stainless Steel Pan Head Screw
facts: This is a fully threaded stainless steel screw, zinc plated and pan headed, measuring 1 mm in diameter and 4 mm in length. It features a 6-lobe Torx drive and a blunt tip for thread forming. The screw is used to secure a universal accessory connector printed circuit board assembly to the bottom of a control box assembly for a Delta Zulu Headset. The specific SKU number is 311-00054-000.A1, and it is described as an M1-.8 × 4 Pan head, T-6 Torx, Plastic Thread Forming Screw.

title: Panettone
facts: The product is a round, fruit-filled sweet bread, commonly known as Panettone, inspired by Italian tradition and popular during Christmas and Easter. It is manufactured in Brazil from wheat flour, water, cane sugar, vegetable oils, eggs, natural yeast, raisins (sourced from Turkey), candied orange, candied papaya, butter, mono and diglycerides, candied citron, barley malt extract, salt, artificial and natural flavors, calcium propionate, additional vegetable oil, and beta carotene. The production process includes dough starters, fermentation, dough mixing, cutting, rounding, depositing dough into molds, decorating, baking, and packaging. The finished product is sold in ambient condition, packaged in 16-ounce cardboard cartons for retail sale.

title: Industrial Data Cable
facts: The product is an industrial data cable identified by part number EX0664. It consists of two individually insulated copper conductors enclosed within an inner sheath, a tape shield, a drain wire, a braided shield, and an outer PVC sheath. The cable is not fitted with connectors at either end. It is rated at 250V and is used primarily for data transmission applications.

title: Decorative Garden Arbor
facts: The item is a decorative garden arbor identified by SKU 1713420. It is constructed from tubular steel with a diameter of approximately 13 mm. In its assembled state, the arbor measures about 55 inches in width, 15 inches in depth, and 102 inches in height. It is intended for residential garden use. The primary function of the arbor is decorative, and it is also designed to support climbing plants such as vines and flowers.

title: Biofran
facts: Biofran is a brown liquid mineral foliar fertilizer formulated to provide nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium for plant nutrition. It contains 3.0% nitrogen, 2.0% phosphorus, and 1.0% potassium, along with amino acids, humic substances, hydrolyzed proteins, and seaweed extract to support plant metabolism and crop development. The product appears as a characteristic-smelling liquid with a pH less than 5 and a density of 1.25 g/mL, and it is fully soluble in water. It is packaged in one-liter plastic containers and is intended exclusively for agricultural use as a foliar fertilizer, with no pesticidal active ingredients or claims.

title: Diclofenac Sodium Gel 1%
facts: The product is a gel containing 1% diclofenac sodium by weight. It is supplied in a 100 gram dosage form intended for topical application to the skin. The gel is used to treat pain and inflammation related to osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis. It is manufactured as a pharmaceutical preparation for external use only. The product is packaged in appropriate containers suitable for retail or medical distribution.

title: Aluminum Shower Door
facts: This is an aluminum shower door designed by Le Corbusier for use in the residence of Maison du Brésil, Cité Internationale Universitaire de Paris. The door measures 61 3/16 inches by 25 3/8 inches. It is constructed from aluminum and functions as a shower enclosure in a residential bathroom setting. The product is intended for installation in a home environment and is sold as a finished shower door assembly.

title: Disposable Postpartum Underwear
facts: This is a women's disposable, seamless boyshort-style brief intended for one-time use. The garment is made from a three-layer laminated material created by melt bond, with elastic threads for stretch support. The top and bottom layers are each made from 100 percent polypropylene spun bond nonwoven fabric, while the middle layer consists of paper pulp. The product is designed for general public use, particularly suitable for postpartum wear, but it is not a stand-alone absorbent sanitary diaper or incontinence brief. It is packaged for retail sale as a single-use undergarment.

title: Decoden Magic Wandercore Craft Kits
facts: Each kit includes a clear plastic case with a handle, various plastic charms, plastic beads, plastic crystals, two 15-milliliter tubes of adhesive, two piping nozzles, a plastic pick-up tool, and a printed instruction sheet. The user applies the adhesive and attaches the plastic embellishments to decorate the case. The case is designed to store all components before and after use. The kits are intended for craft activity users who wish to personalize their storage case with decorative elements. All components are made of plastic except for the adhesive, and the instruction sheet provides guidance for the decorating process.

title: Halloween Bead Set
facts: The product is a Halloween bead set, item number 646606, containing 950 plastic beads of various sizes and colors and a four-meter length of man-made fiber thread. The consumer cuts the thread to the desired length for assembling jewelry items such as bracelets or necklaces using the included beads. All components are housed inside a plastic container shaped like a ghost or skull. The beads and thread are intended for use in creating beaded or jewelry items, with any amusement provided being incidental to the utilitarian purpose of the kit. The set is sold as a craft kit for decorative purposes rather than as wearable jewelry.

title: Lao Xie Zhen Frozen Seafood Cheese Rice Burger
facts: This product is a frozen, ready-to-heat food item consisting of a molded rice patty filled with a seafood and cheese mixture. Each piece is individually quick-frozen (IQF) and retail-packaged in a box containing 10 pieces. The rice patty is made from steamed and braised rice, formed into patties, sprayed with soy sauce, roasted, and IQF frozen. The seafood filling contains shrimp and clams that are cured, steamed, and cooled. Vegetables and seasonings are cleaned, cut, sautéed, and cooled before being combined. Shredded cheese is added during assembly. The final product is assembled, IQF frozen again, individually packaged, metal detected, and externally packaged. Each retail box measures 183 × 183 × 184 millimeters with a net weight of approximately 1,950 grams. The product is intended for home preparation via microwave or oven heating and serves as a standalone main course meal. The product is shipped in full cold chain conditions at or below -18 degrees Celsius.

title: Lightly Lined Longline Bralette
facts: The item is a knit bralette composed of 67% nylon and 33% spandex. It features a V-front design with adjustable shoulder straps and soft foam cups. The bralette includes a partial lining of mesh fabric and mesh trim along the upper portion of both the front and back. A change in the knit pattern creates a tighter fit under the bustline. An alternative version is 1.5 inches shorter in length but otherwise identical in design and materials.

title: Used 2000 Lada Niva 4x4 Off-Road Utility Vehicle
facts: This is a used 2000 model year Lada Niva 4x4, also known as model VAZ-2121 or Lada 4x4. It is a three-door compact off-road utility vehicle designed primarily for transporting persons. The vehicle features a permanent all-wheel drive system with a lockable center differential and a low-range transfer case. It is powered by a 1.7-liter inline-four spark-ignition engine. The vehicle’s weight ranges from 1,100 to 1,300 kilograms and has approximately 117,675 kilometers of mileage. The vehicle is refurbished with recent mechanical work but retains its original, unmodified design.

title: Metal Free-Standing Storage Racks
facts: The goods are two types of free-standing storage racks made from 14-gauge steel. The first type, a horizontal rack, has a load capacity of 2,000 lbs and, when assembled, measures approximately 60 inches in length, 66 inches in height, and 36 inches in depth, weighing 62 lbs. After assembly, it features left and right 'A' frames, each equipped with seven forward and seven rear weight-bearing metal hangers. The second type, a vertical rack, has a load capacity of 1,000 lbs and, when assembled, measures approximately 37 inches in width, 71 inches in height, and 25 inches in depth, weighing 71 lbs. After assembly, it includes twelve metal hangers to keep contents upright and organized. Both racks are imported unassembled and unequipped, with all necessary hardware for assembly included.

title: King George Adult Costume
facts: The costume is an adult-sized ensemble that includes a coat, vest, pull-on pants, cape, cravat, and crown. The coat is made from a flimsy man-made knitted textile and features an open front with no closure. The sleeves and hem bottom of the coat have raw, unfinished edges and are stitched together with a single line of long, loose straight stitching. All components of the costume are designed to be worn together for a complete look suitable for theatrical or themed events.

title: GripVR Hand-Held Virtual Reality Controller
facts: The GripVR, model SVP-VC2B, is a hand-held wireless remote controller designed for use with SteamVR tracking-compatible virtual reality headsets. It operates through radio frequency (RF) to remotely control applications displayed on the headset. The controller features six buttons: AB/XY, trigger, grip, system, joystick press, and one joystick, along with a thumb rest. It includes a lithium-ion rechargeable battery for power. The device is intended for users engaging with virtual reality applications and is typically used while holding the controller in the hand.

title: Hydraulic Units
facts: These hydraulic units, known as MarzocchiPompes, are available in ALM1, ALM2, ALM3, GHM1, GHM2, and GHM3 series. Each unit is constructed with an aluminum casing that includes an inlet, an outlet, and a flange cover. Inside the casing and flange cover are bearings and two gears with shafts. When connected to an external motor, the unit operates as a pump. When supplied with pressurized oil, the gear rotation reverses, enabling the unit to function like a motor. The series vary in speed, suction range, and displacement, which are essential operational characteristics for pump functionality.

title: Framed Preserved Floral Bouquet
facts: This decorative wall art features preserved natural flowers collected from a wedding bouquet and treated with a silica gel desiccation process. Each flower undergoes a detailed chromatic restoration to match its original color, using wedding photographs as a reference and taking four to six hours per flower. The flowers are hand-assembled petal by petal into either a three-dimensional floral sculpture or a pressed botanical arrangement. The completed floral composition is enclosed under museum-grade anti-ultraviolet, anti-reflective glass that provides about 99 percent UV protection. The enclosure is mounted in a handcrafted wooden frame made from oak, walnut, or wenge wood and finished with natural plant-based oils. The finished piece serves as decorative wall art.

title: Halloween Wall/Door Decor
facts: The product is an assortment of two styles of wall or door decorations, each featuring a large decorative bow made from man-made material, measuring 12 inches wide by 16 inches long, with a loop for hanging. Style A includes a plastic skull positioned at the center of the bow, surrounded by stiff grey material designed to resemble witch hair. Style B includes a plastic witch hat and legs, suggesting a witch who has crashed into the bow. Both styles are attached to a Halloween-themed header card for display and are intended for seasonal Halloween use only.

title: MOSFET Transistors
facts: These are metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors with part numbers DMC2053UVTQ-7 and DMC2053UVTQ-13, designed for general-purpose use in automotive applications such as backlighting, DC-DC converters, and power management. Each transistor includes an N-Channel die and a P-Channel die enclosed in a TSOT26 case with six terminal pins. The operating frequency is 1 Mhz. When mounted with the minimum recommended pad layout, the power dissipation rate is 0.7 W, increasing to 1.1 W when using a 1-inch square copper plate, which is the maximum achievable power dissipation rate. The only difference between the variants is the packaging: DMC2053UVTQ-7 is supplied on a 7-inch reel, while DMC2053UVTQ-13 is supplied on a 13-inch reel.

title: Plastic Tote Bag with Wheels
facts: The article is a tote bag made from plastic sheeting for the outer surface. It measures approximately 15.75 inches in length, 11.8 inches in width, and 19.7 inches in height. The bag includes three handles for carrying by hand and two wheels for rolling along surfaces. It closes with a zipper and is intended for multipurpose use such as camping, shopping, and picnicking. The bag is designed to store, protect, organize, and transport personal effects during travel. It is sold as a standalone storage and portability solution.

title: Hair Clip Decoration Kit
facts: The kit is identified as item DK0069001 and is designed for decorating hair accessories. It contains one plastic claw hair clip, two smaller plastic hair clips, two sheets of imitation gemstone stickers, and a pair of metal tweezers. The stickers are applied to the hair clips by the user to customize their appearance. The kit is intended for personal use in decorating hair accessories. All components are supplied loose within the packaging, with no assembly required prior to use.

title: Power Reclining Chaise Sectional Sofa
facts: The Power Reclining Chaise Sectional Sofa (Model 5150) is an upholstered sectional sofa with a wooden frame. It consists of six components: a Left-Arm Facing Power Recliner, an Armless Chair, a Round Corner, an Armless Power Chair, a Straight Console with USB, and a Right-Arm Facing Power Chaise. The backrests, seat foundations, and armrests are constructed using 'S' tension springs, foam, textile tension bands bound to wooden structural frames, and fiber encased in textiles. The sofa is designed to seat one or more individuals and does not include an integrated mattress or convert into a bed. Each component contains assembly hardware such as connection posts and clips for assembling into various configurations, sold individually and combinable into 2-piece, 3-piece, 4-piece, or larger units. The complete sectional measures approximately 117 inches in length, 130 inches in width, and 39 inches in height.

title: Fitted Carry Case for Neuro 20 PRO System
facts: The article is a fitted carry case designed specifically for the Neuro 20 PRO system. It is constructed with an outer surface made of man-made textile materials. The case features one handle and a three-sided zipper for closure. It is imported empty and separate from the Neuro 20 PRO system, which includes a Smart Suit, control box, tablet, and software. The case is intended to protect and organize the components of the Neuro 20 PRO system during transport and storage.

title: Indian-Style Dumplings
facts: These are three varieties of Indian-style dumplings imported frozen in sealed plastic packaging, each variety weighing between 45.85 and 58.12 ounces net. Each dumpling consists of a pastry wrapper made from maida (highly refined and bleached wheat flour), corn starch, water, hydrogenated vegetable fat, and a flour treatment agent. The fillings vary by variety: 'Corn and Cheese Momo' contains sweet corn, cheese block, melted cheese, capsicum (green, red, yellow), butter, refined sunflower oil, and a corn cheese premix; 'Krunchyy Corn and Cheese Momo' contains similar ingredients to the first but with a different premix; 'Veg Exotica Momo' contains cabbage, onion, carrot, binding mince (soya), refined sunflower oil, butter, ginger, coriander, and an exotic momo premix. The dumplings are manufactured by mixing and resting the dough, preparing and mixing the fillings, then using an automatic forming machine to deposit filling onto the wrapper, fold and seal it into shape. The formed dumplings are steam cooked, cooled, IQF frozen, and stored at approximately -18 Celsius until dispatch. Consumers are instructed to heat the dumplings via steaming, air frying, or microwaving.

title: ABS Plastic Wall Mount Bracket for WiFi Router
facts: The item is a wall mount bracket made entirely of acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS) plastic. It is designed to be fixed to a wall surface to hold and support a standard WiFi router. The bracket is molded from ABS in a single piece and includes attachment points for secure mounting. It is intended for indoor residential or commercial use to elevate and position WiFi routers optimally. The bracket is supplied loose, without any additional components or packaging beyond protective wrapping, and is sold individually to consumers or installers of networking equipment.

title: Pulse 2.0 Logic Board
facts: The Pulse 2.0 Logic Board is a printed circuit board assembly that serves as the network communication subsystem for an industrial energy monitor. It receives digitized energy measurement data from a connected Energy Board using an internal serial peripheral interface (SPI) bus. The board converts this data into MQTT-formatted JSON payloads over a TLS 1.3-secured TCP/IP stack. It transmits these payloads to cloud infrastructure via WiFi or an Ethernet module connected through a USB interface. The assembly is manufactured in China and supplied as a standalone component for integration into larger monitoring systems.

title: Wheeled Tote Bag
facts: The item is a tote bag with an outer surface made of plastic sheeting. It includes casters and four wheels for mobility. The interior contains foam padding and features a zipper closure. It has three handles: one located on the right side, and two handles on the front and back sides. The dimensions of the tote bag are 18 inches in length, 14 inches in width, and 24 inches in height.

title: Digital Signal Processor for Loudspeaker Systems
facts: The device, model number DSPx 2.4, is a digital signal processor used within high-performance loudspeaker systems. It consists of various electronic components including an onboard DSP chipset, enclosed in a metal housing. The front of the device features a rotary dial, while the back includes multiple input and output connections such as analog audio (RCA and XLR), digital audio (S/PDIF), and wireless connectivity. The device receives and processes audio signals from an input source, converting digital signals to analog for use by various outputs like speakers, tweeters, and subwoofers. It can divide frequencies, perform equalization, and adjust levels across multiple channels but does not amplify sound.

title: Gas-Fired Condensing Hydronic Boiler
facts: This is a gas-fired condensing hydronic boiler designed for commercial and industrial heating applications, part of the Absolute Spire series with model numbers ranging from SP500 to SP8000. Each unit features a rectangular metal enclosure with removable panels and includes grooved supply and return manifolds for water connections. Additional openings on the unit are for a combustion air intake, a drain valve, a condensate drain, a flue vent outlet, and a gas inlet. A touchscreen control system is mounted on the side of the unit. Inside, the boiler contains a stainless-steel water tube heat exchanger and combustion chamber, a diagnostic control panel, and a burner assembly that includes a combustion blower and a gas valve. The boilers vary in physical dimensions and technical specifications such as maximum gas input, water capacity, and maximum flow rate, with rated heat outputs ranging from 454 to 7,808 MBH.

title: Handmade Decorative Wall Sign
facts: The article is a handmade decorative wall sign composed of a cotton tubular braid with a steel wire threaded through it. The wire is bent and twisted to form words or shapes, which are entirely concealed within the braid and used solely to maintain the structural shape of the design. Adhesive is applied to join different colors and to close the ends of the braid. Each piece is personalized and handmade, resulting in variable dimensions, though most measure roughly 8 to 16 inches in height and 8 to 24 inches in width. The lightweight decoration mounts directly to the wall using small nails, adhesive hooks, or mounting tape, and functions purely as an indoor wall decoration. The product is sold exclusively online through Etsy, social media, and the Renartgifts brand website.

title: The Comforter Bubble Bar
facts: The Comforter Bubble Bar is a solid bath bar supplied unpackaged. It is composed of sodium laureth sulfate, cream of tartar, sodium bicarbonate, and additional ingredients. The bar is used by crumbling it or holding it under running water. This action creates a fragrant, colorful, and bubbly bath. It is intended for personal use in bathing and is typically used by individuals during a shower or bath.

title: Refrigerant Receiver Tank
facts: The item is a cylindrical, pressurized container made of steel with a capacity of 3.4 liters. It is designed to hold and store liquid refrigerant. The container attaches to the condenser coil of an HVAC system. It contains no mechanical components or valves and functions solely as a passive containment vessel. The tank operates within a duct system and has no active role in the air conditioning process. It is supplied as a standalone component without any additional packaging or accessories.

title: Used 2000 Subaru Impreza WRX STI Sedan
facts: This is a used four-door sedan from the 2000 model year manufactured by Subaru in Japan. The vehicle is designed to seat five passengers including the driver. It features a right-hand drive configuration and is powered by an unmodified Subaru EJ207 4-cylinder, 1,994 cc turbocharged spark-ignition internal combustion engine. The vehicle identification number is GD8-001368. The car is a Japanese-market model and remains in its original specification with no modifications.

title: Vehicle Towing Hook
facts: The article is a steel rod with a threaded end and an eye on the opposite end. The threaded portion attaches to a mounting point on a vehicle’s underside beneath the bumper, while the eye extends horizontally to serve as an attachment point for towing cables, ropes, or hooks. It measures 278 mm in length and weighs 0.820 kg. The component is made of steel and is sold individually, intended for use in vehicle towing applications.

title: Reversible Pinnies
facts: These are sleeveless, pullover garments designed for athletic use. Each style is constructed from knit mesh fabric, either 100% polyester or a blend of 88% polyester and 12% spandex. The men's styles feature either a large rounded neckline or a V-neckline, while the women's styles include a racerback design with either a large rounded neckline. All pinnies have oversized armholes and a hemmed bottom. They are reversible, offering two distinct appearances, and are intended for use by men or women depending on the style.

title: Fento Original Knee Protectors
facts: The Fento Original knee protectors, product number F280221, feature an ethylene-vinyl acetate (EVA) plastic foam outer layer and a polyurethane (PU) plastic foam inner layer. Polyester elastic straps are used to secure the protectors around the knee. These protectors are designed to provide stability and impact protection while the wearer is in a kneeling position. The product is intended for use by individuals who need knee support during activities such as work, sports, or other physical tasks. The protectors come packaged as a pair and are sold individually per unit.

title: Knee Board
facts: The item is a knee board identified as product number F280500. It functions as a pad designed to evenly distribute pressure across the knees and lower legs when a user kneels on it. The board is constructed entirely from polyurethane (PU) plastic foam. It features ventilation holes, an anti-slip bottom layer, and a molded-in handle for portability. The board measures 19.5 inches in length, 11 inches in width, and 1.8 inches in height. It is supplied to end users for personal use in activities requiring kneeling support.

title: Aspen Wood Shavings
facts: The product consists of loose aspen wood shavings, supplied in unpackaged bulk form without agglomeration. These shavings are packaged in three commercial sizes: individual 1kg bags, 4kg boxes, and 10kg boxes. The material is intended for use as bedding for small caged animals including rabbits, hamsters, and similar pets. The shavings are dry, untreated wood fibers produced through mechanical shredding processes. There are no added chemicals, binding agents, or synthetic materials present in the product. The goods originate from China and are sold for animal care purposes only.

title: LH Wire INR Automobile Seat Component
facts: The LH Wire INR (88387-DN840) is a cold-bent steel metal wire shaped into a specific form. It is permanently welded to the lower frame of an automobile seat according to Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) specifications. The component measures approximately 10cm x 3cm x 3.5cm. It supports a seat cover to keep it properly positioned and shaped. The wire engages with the seat cover pocket, drawing the cover taut against the seat foam. Used with the seat’s shield cover, it maintains the curvature, contour, and finish of upholstery materials and conceals underlying wiring harnesses, motors, and other seat components.

title: Halloween Decoration Figure
facts: The item is a decorative depiction of the NBC character Jack Skellington. It is a man-made stuffed textile figure wearing a pinstriped suit and bat tie. The figure is permanently attached to a circular, flat plastic base. The total height including the base measures approximately 12 inches. The product is sold exclusively as a Halloween decoration.
